chapter: California, Cats and the Fiddle, the Tatum trio
title: Los Angeles, the Three Deuces, and the trio's agent problem
summary: After the Streets of Paris the trio went to New York and toured widely; Nat Cole beat them to a film, but he coached the dancers in Stormy Weather.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Streets of Paris... we stayed out there the longest time. Then somehow or other we got a call to go to New York. We went to this place called the 3 Deuces. And we stayed there a long, long time. And then we went out, Cleveland, Chicago, we went everywhere. We were in demand. Didn't have the right agent.
--- Aguy associated with William Morris, he was the cause of everything breaking up ---
... We'd like to have gotten in a good picture, but Nat Cole beat us out. I played the music for Moke and Poke in "Stormy Weather." I used to rehearse them, the two dancers.
